facts.fact: An ECOWAS Parliament delegation said Liberia is progressively implementing SIGMAT, the interconnected system for goods in transit, and saw its advantages over the manual customs system.
Gambian MP Maimuna Cessay said SIGMAT implementation, limited to a number of countries, includes Sierra Leone.
Gambian MP Maimuna Cessay said SIGMAT implementation, limited to a number of countries, includes Cote d'Ivoire.
Gambian MP Maimuna Cessay said SIGMAT implementation, limited to a number of countries, includes Guinea.
Delegation vice chair Seno Soklingi cited Togo as a country where SIGMAT has been integrated into customs operations.
Delegation vice chair Seno Soklingi cited Benin as a country where SIGMAT has been integrated into customs operations.
